old_wooden_house.name: Old Wooden House
old_wooden_house.description: A small, cozy wooden house surrounded by forest. Rain taps steadily against the windows. A weak fire flickers in the stone fireplace, filling the room with the smell of smoke and damp wood. The front door is locked.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: A cramped kitchen with old wooden cabinets and a cold iron stove. Several empty jars sit on a dusty shelf.

upstairs.name: Upstairs
upstairs.description: A narrow wooden hallway stretches through the upper floor. Several doors line the walls. The floor creaks beneath your weight.

forest_edge.name: Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: The house stands at the edge of a vast forest. Rain falls through the branches, turning the earth into dark mud. A barely visible trail disappears between the trees.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.description: The forest becomes darker and quieter here. Ancient trees tower overhead, their branches blocking most of the gray afternoon sky.
